subject: Structured offer: observability retention + tracing egress credits
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Structured offer: observability retention + tracing egress credits

Hi Samantha / Ravi —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a compact proposal that aims to reduce variability on your monthly bill while preserving predictability as you scale traces and dashboards. Highlights in plain language: 

- 30-day default retention included with base bundle (no additional charge).
- Tiered preservation credits: additional 30/90/365 day buckets available as committed credits (pre-purchased at stepped discounts).
- Tracing egress: nominal per-million-span fee for cross-region export; waived up to 5M spans for the first three months of a commitment.
- Advanced dashboards: seat-based billing remains, but we offer a shared "enterprise dashboards" allowance (up to 12 dashboards) in Year 1 for customers who meet the committed credits threshold.

Attached is redwood_obs_pricing_v2.pdf with the pricing table and two concession paths (Credit-First or Capped-Egress). I recommend the Credit-First path as it provides the most unit-cost savings if Nimbus expects bursty analysis windows.

Can you confirm which path you'd prefer and whether you need a hard cap on egress costs? I can loop in Pricing/Product if you'd like us to bake a tailored number.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com]
[Attachment: redwood_obs_pricing_v2.pdf (8KB)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@nimbushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 13:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Structured offer: observability retention + tracing egress credits

Jordan —

Thanks for the proposal. We like the idea of committing to credits rather than flat per-day charges, but two asks before we move to legal:

1) Can you put a 3-month rolling cap on egress charges? We want to avoid surprise spikes during data backfills.
2) For advanced dashboards: instead of seat-only, can we get a metric-based concession? Our product analytics team spins up dozens of dashboards for experiments and we prefer a per-metric rate rather than increasing seats.

Ravi and I reviewed the numbers quickly and the Credit-First path helps, but the egress clause is still a concern. If you can guarantee a soft cap (with overage alerts + a fixed overage threshold we can opt into), we can move to a 12-month commitment.

Samantha Lee
Head of Data Platforms | Nimbus Health
[samantha.lee@nimbushealth.com]
[Attachment: nimbus_mop_feedback.docx (2KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus asks — 3mo egress cap + metric-based dashboard concession

Kimberly / Karthik —

Looping you both on Nimbus (NB-2387). They like Credit-First, but require: (A) a 3-month rolling soft cap on tracing egress with opt-in fixed overage threshold + alerts; and (B) metric-based concession for advanced dashboards (per-metric unit or a hybrid seat+metric allowance).

Questions:
- Pricing: can we structure a 3-month rolling cap that converts to an overage credit when exceeded (i.e., we absorb up to X then bill at reduced overage rate)? If so, what's the math for 100k / 500k / 1M span caps?
- Product: is there an easy way to convert dashboard allowances into a per-metric billing meter? If not, can we offer a hybrid: 6 seats + 100 metrics included?

Customer is willing to sign 12 months if we can give a clear playbook on alerts + a predictable cap. I attached the proposal they returned with comments.

Thanks — Jordan

--- Forwarded attachment: nimbus_mop_feedback.docx ---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Structured offer: observability retention + tracing egress credits

Samantha / Jordan / Karthik —

Appreciate the clear asks — we can accommodate both concession items with a single, simple structure that balances predictability and unit economics: 

1) 3-month rolling soft cap on tracing egress: Redwood will waive overage charges up to the cap for three months; if the cap is exceeded in any month, Redwood will automatically apply a reduced overage rate for the remainder of the quarter and notify the customer at 80% and 100% thresholds. Option to convert the soft cap into a hard cap by pre-purchasing a one-time cap buffer credit. Sample tiers (monthly equivalent):
   - 100k spans/month cap: waived overage up to cap; overage at $2.50 per 1M spans thereafter (discounted).
   - 500k spans/month cap: overage at $2.00 per 1M spans thereafter.
   - 1M spans/month cap: overage at $1.50 per 1M spans thereafter.

2) Advanced dashboards — hybrid metric-seat allowance:
   - 6 seats included + 100 metrics (charts) across enterprise dashboards.
   - Additional metrics billed at $0.10 per metric/month (tiered discount beyond 1k metrics).
   - For customers who truly need seat flexibility, we can swap 2 seats for an extra 200 metric allowance in Year 1.

We will surface alerts in the Console (80%/100%) and include a monthly egress usage report as part of the billing package. If Nimbus signs the 12-month commitment for the Credit-First path at the proposed commit levels (see redwood_obs_pricing_v2.pdf), we will waive the first-month egress for onboarding backfills and include a one-time migration credit.

Samantha — if that sounds acceptable I can update the pdf and we can push to procurement/legal. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to finalize numbers.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference
[kimberly_park@redwood.com]
